plain: David Grusch, a former US intelligence officer who says he uncovered secret government programs dealing with recovered craft, said on Jesse Michels's podcast what he would ask two scientists from the 1940s and 50s if he could. He named Robert Sarbacher, a scientist who advised the government, and Robert Oppenheimer, the physicist who led the building of the atomic bomb. Grusch says he would ask them what they were thinking when they hid all of this away, which suggests he believes they helped start the secrecy.
